description: This template checks the availability of required tools before proceeding to the next phase of the pipeline.

ghCli.description: Check if GitHub CLI is available in the environment.

ollama.description: Check if Ollama is available in the environment.

jq.description: Check if jq is available in the environment.

deepWiki.description: Check if deepWiki is available in the environment.
deepWiki.command: LLM agent checks if deepWiki is available in current harness.

validatorAgent.description: Check if validatorAgent is available in the environment. LLM agent checks if any of the following is available in the current harness: sub-agent, peer-agent, RLM or similar mechanism which ensures that the validator agent will be separate from the current agent and LLM (not biased)
validatorAgent.command: LLM agent checks the harness for a sub-agent, peer-agent, RLM or similar mechanism that keeps the validator separate from the current agent and LLM. check-tools.sh does not detect this.
